findings.current: Why had the Embroidered Uniform Guard—an agency directly under the Emperor—appeared in Anhui Province in disguise, unlike usual?
findings.defect: The source distinguishes changing clothes (line 245) from changing identities here. The English repeats the disguise detail instead, omitting that their identities had been changed.
findings.rationale: The phrase “신분까지 바꿔 가며” specifies that they went so far as to change their identities, a detail not conveyed by repeating that they were in disguise.
findings.replacement: Why had the Embroidered Uniform Guard—an agency directly under the Emperor—appeared in Anhui Province, even going so far as to change their identities?

summary: The translation is largely faithful, but it omits the detail that the Embroidered Uniform Guard had changed their identities.
